visual_style: Vertical 9:16, crisp warm daylight, energetic realistic cinematic look with named camera moves. Pakistani settings: government schools with whitewashed walls, plain green blackboards with no writing, wooden desks, pupils in school uniform. Modest dress. No on-screen text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame; papers and screens are blurred and unreadable. Recipe v2: in shots 1 and 5 the on-screen presenter speaks to the camera; in shots 2-4 an unseen narrator speaks as a voice-over and nobody on screen speaks.

narrator.name: presenter and voice-over
narrator.description: On screen in shots 1 and 5: a confident Pakistani woman teacher in a maroon shalwar kameez and a beige dupatta, speaking Urdu to the camera with a lively, quick, enthusiastic delivery. Shots 2-4: an unseen Pakistani woman narrator, lively and quick, voice-over only.

shots.visual: At a busy town chowk with rickshaws and a tea stall, a confident Pakistani woman teacher in a maroon shalwar kameez and a beige dupatta looks around at the crowd, then turns to the camera; quick push-in to a close-up.
Handheld orbit around a three-generation family sharing a meal on a floor dastarkhwan at home, grandparents laughing with children.
Fast tracking shot through a busy market street, past a factory gate, to a school gate where pupils stream out.
Rising crane shot over a classroom where trainee teachers sit in a circle in lively discussion.

In a sunlit school corridor, a confident Pakistani woman teacher in a maroon shalwar kameez and a beige dupatta walks briskly toward the camera, holds up a phone with a blurred screen and smiles; fast push-in to a close-up as pupils walk past softly in the background.

narration: ہم جیسا سوچتے اور جیتے ہیں، اس کے پیچھے معاشرہ کیسے کام کرتا ہے؟
اس کورس میں آپ sociology کے بنیادی نظریات، culture اور socialization سمجھیں گے۔
